acceptanceSteps: An owner or authorized administrator installs or authorizes the Pages CMS GitHub App for the private repository.
The office editor signs in and opens the main branch.
The editor makes a harmless announcement-text edit while keeping the announcement hidden.
The editor saves the change and runs Build and verify website.
The owner confirms the GitHub commit, successful workflow, and Cloudflare rebuild.
The owner restores the prior wording and confirms the recovery commit and rebuild.

legacySite.hostingObservation: The web address is within a GoDaddy-owned network range, so the legacy origin is likely hosted on GoDaddy infrastructure.
legacySite.hostingProductNeeded: Confirm the exact GoDaddy product, subscription owner, renewal date, control-panel access, document root, backups, and cancellation timing from the GoDaddy account or invoice.
legacySite.mailObservation: Microsoft 365 mail routing and Outlook autodiscover are publicly visible; the current SPF record also references secureserver.net.
legacySite.tlsObservation: The legacy certificate was observed expired, but that alone does not prove the remaining website content or hosting account is unavailable.
legacySite.migrationRule: Change only the apex and www web records after preserving every mail and application record.

tools.label: Self-edit website CMS
blockers: Authorize the Pages CMS GitHub App for the private repository.
Confirm who will hold repository and editor access.
Complete a real save, verification workflow, Cloudflare rebuild, and recovery exercise.

tools.label: Website hosting and deployment
blockers: Complete all launch evidence.
Attach the real domain during an approved change window.
Change only the minimum apex and www records and verify rollback.

tools.label: Public-form bot protection
blockers: Create an office-controlled widget.
Restrict the widget to approved preview and production hostnames.
Store the site key and secret only in Cloudflare environment settings.
Complete a real verification test.

tools.label: General administrative inquiry delivery
tools.provider: Basin through the same-origin Cloudflare function
tools.cost: $0 for light testing; current paid entry tier is approximately $12.50 per month when billed yearly
blockers: Decide whether launch remains preview-only or enables delivery.
Create an office-owned Basin endpoint and notification mailbox.
Approve retention, deletion, response owner, backup owner, and rate limiting.
Complete successful and failure-path delivery tests without PHI.

tools.label: Privacy-first website analytics
blockers: Approve whether analytics is needed at launch.
Create the site in the office-controlled Cloudflare account.
Add and test the beacon without collecting form contents or patient information.
Update public privacy wording before enabling.

tools.label: Search ownership and indexing
blockers: Complete the real-domain cutover and canonical-host verification.
Approve public indexing.
Verify domain ownership and submit the production sitemap.

tools.label: Secure online patient intake
tools.provider: Not selected; Jotform HIPAA or a dental-platform forms product are candidates
tools.cost: Jotform currently advertises HIPAA-enabled features on Gold at about $99 per month billed annually; dental-platform pricing is generally quote-based
blockers: Confirm the practice-management system and required integrations.
Select a healthcare-capable vendor and execute an appropriate BAA.
Approve access roles, consent, retention, deletion, incident response, and staff workflow.
Keep the current public repository and Basin inquiry path free of PHI.

tools.label: Online scheduling, patient messaging, payments, and reviews
tools.provider: Not selected; NexHealth or the practice's existing dental platform are candidates
blockers: Identify the current practice-management and patient-communication systems.
Confirm supported read/write integration and prevent duplicate scheduling or messaging workflows.
Execute required agreements and approve staff ownership, downtime, reconciliation, and rollback procedures.
Test in a vendor sandbox or controlled pilot before adding website links or widgets.
